problem: Checkout needs a cart total built from line prices.
scope: Implement src/money.js and src/cart.js, and test the cart total.
requirement: cartTotal of a 250 by 2 line and a 100 by 1 line MUST equal 600.
approach: Write the cart assertion, watch it fail, then implement lineTotal and cartTotal and rerun the same file.
task: Land the claimed behavior and record the verification command.
title: Total a cart across money and cart modules
description: Both modules start unimplemented. test/cart.test.js asserts that a line of 250 cents times 2 plus a line of 100 cents equals 600. The same node:test command fails while cartTotal throws, then passes after lineTotal multiplies price by quantity and cartTotal sums those lines.
rubricNote: Behavior change across two production files. One assertion failed before the implementation and passes after it, and red and green run that same test.
claim: I added lineTotal in src/money.js and cartTotal in src/cart.js. test/cart.test.js asserts a 250×2 line plus a 100×1 line equals 600. node --test test/cart.test.js failed because cartTotal threw "not implemented". I implemented both functions and reran the same command. It passed.
